Class GuardrailProperties.SemanticProperties

java.lang.Object
com.gridynamics.forge.guardrail.config.GuardrailProperties.SemanticProperties
Enclosing class:
GuardrailProperties
public static class GuardrailProperties.SemanticProperties extends Object
Top-level switch for the semantic validation layer. Disabled by default — enable by setting forge.guardrail.semantic.enabled=true and providing an ONNX model, pgvector table, and (optionally) Redis.
